settings.title: Blush and
settings.summary: Baby pink Austin roses with light peach ranunculus in a cream vase.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Austin Roses | Baby Pink | 6 stems | B0DTFNXBHF | #e6b7b5 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=Baby+Pink | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Light Peach | 4 stems | B0DTYG3SY1 | #eac3a9 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Light+Peach | Secondary
settings.method:
Set the six roses first at slightly different heights, the tallest about twice the height of the vase.
Add the ranunculus lower and to the sides, letting the buds stand a little above the roses.
Turn the vase until the outline looks gathered rather than round.
settings.why: Two neighbouring pinks. The Austin roses lead; the smaller ranunculus fill the gaps and repeat the peach at the centre of each rose.
settings.alt: Baby pink Austin roses with light peach ranunculus in a cream vase.

settings.title: Coral
settings.summary: Coral classic roses with orange ranunculus in a stone jug.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Roses | Coral | 6 stems | B0DSWT9NMF | #d98268 | /?view=sskoi-classic#color=Coral | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Orange | 4 stems | B0DTYBG3DP | #dc884d | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Orange | Secondary
settings.method:
Place the roses first and let a few buds lean out over the rim.
Add the ranunculus low, close to the lip of the jug.
Leave one side lighter than the other so the arrangement looks gathered, not packed.
settings.why: Coral and orange sit next to each other on the colour wheel. The open roses and their buds carry the shape; the orange ranunculus warm the base.
settings.alt: Coral classic roses with orange ranunculus in a stone jug.

settings.title: White
settings.summary: White tulips, Austin roses and ranunculus in a wide stoneware crock.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | White | 12 stems | B0DQDXM72R | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=White | Line
1 | Austin Roses | White | 6 stems | B0DTFNZQRG | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=White | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | White | 4 stems | B0DTYJ5V1W | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=White | Secondary
settings.method:
Stand the tulips around the rim first, leaning out to set the width.
Place the roses in the centre at two or three different heights.
Fill the gaps with the ranunculus and let a few tulips rise above everything.
settings.why: One colour, three textures: smooth tulips for height, cupped Austin roses as the focal point, layered ranunculus with silvery leaves in between.
settings.alt: White tulips, Austin roses and ranunculus in a wide stoneware crock.

settings.title: Pink and
settings.summary: Green-and-pink tulips with pink Austin roses and pink ranunculus.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | Green With Pink Tip | 12 stems | B0DQF16XSS | #c5c6a3 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=Green+With+Pink+Tip | Line
1 | Austin Roses | Pink | 6 stems | B0DTFPD9F9 | #d982a6 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=Pink | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Pink | 4 stems | B0DTYBPB9F | #d982a6 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Pink | Secondary
settings.method:
Start with the tulips around the rim, leaning out.
Place the roses in the middle at different heights.
Tuck the ranunculus between the roses and let the buds stand above them.
settings.why: Three pinks at different scales, tied together by the green of the tulips. The tulips draw the lines, the roses hold the centre, the ranunculus add detail.
settings.alt: Green-and-pink tulips with pink Austin roses and pink ranunculus.

settings.title: Soft
settings.summary: White classic roses with pink tips and baby pink ranunculus in a slim vase.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Roses | White With Pink Tip | 6 stems | B0DSWSM1QY | #f2e4de | /?view=sskoi-classic#color=White+With+Pink+Tip | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Baby Pink | 4 stems | B0DTYL1GYT | #e6b7b5 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Baby+Pink | Secondary
settings.method:
Set the roses so the open blooms sit low and the buds rise above.
Add the ranunculus to one side for an off-centre outline.
Keep the top of the arrangement below the lampshade so the light falls on the petals.
settings.why: The pink edges on the white roses are picked up by the baby pink ranunculus, so the two sets read as one soft colour.
settings.alt: White classic roses with pink tips and baby pink ranunculus in a slim vase.

settings.title: Late
settings.summary: Burgundy classic roses with dark purple tulips in smoked glass.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Roses | Burgundy | 6 stems | B0DSXY4KDH | #6d283f | /?view=sskoi-classic#color=Burgundy | Focal
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | Dark Purple | 12 stems | B0DQDVL846 | #654181 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=Dark+Purple | Line
settings.method:
Stand the tulips first and let them fall open toward the rim.
Place the roses through the middle, open blooms low and buds high.
Light the table from one side; the dark petals need it.
settings.why: Burgundy and dark purple share their depth. The tall tulips draw the outline; the roses and their buds give it weight at the centre.
settings.alt: Burgundy classic roses with dark purple tulips in smoked glass.
